summary_step: 1. Returns invalid probe info when the controller is not in hangover state.
2. Computes settle wait from configured RTT count and smoothed RTT in seconds.
3. Clamps settle wait between configured minimum and maximum durations.
4. Returns invalid probe info when hangover time has not yet reached settle wait.
5. Returns the stored probe cluster info and resets state to idle once the wait elapses.
